---
title: "Grid listing, description with a link"
listing:
  id: description-links
  type: grid
  contents:
    - path: https://example.com/article
      title: "Article"
      description: "Read the article, see the [docs](https://example.org/docs)."
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # the card's link to the item stretches over the card from the title
          - ".quarto-listing-container-grid .listing-title a.quarto-grid-link.stretched-link[href='https://example.com/article']"
          - ".quarto-listing-container-grid .quarto-grid-item .listing-description span"
        -
          # the link must be removed, it would sit under the stretched link
          - ".quarto-listing-container-grid .listing-description a[href='https://example.org/docs']"
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # the link text is kept
          - '<span>docs</span>'
---

::: {#description-links}
:::

The grid listing links each item card from its title, and the link stretches
over the whole card. A link inside the description would sit under that
stretched link, so it could not be clicked. The description link must be
turned into plain text instead.
